name: relay
tagline: An analog signal-sorting mystery for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
description: A decommissioned coastal relay station. Old analog transmissions come in and you work shifts sorting them into the right archive channels, while the story hidden in the static pieces itself together one fragment at a time. Free to start, with a single unlock for the full Archive.

name: NotchGames
tagline: Tiny Mac games you pull out of the notch, starting with neon Pong.
description: Move your pointer to the notch and a black drop stretches towards it. Pull it down and a game court grows out of the notch, sized by how far you pull. Play a quick match of Pong against the computer at one of four difficulty levels, then push it back up into the notch and get on with your day. No Dock icon, no window to switch to, no special permissions.
